storyScope.centralIncident: Suspicious person bolts on foot through residential yards and alleyways before a violent struggle in a drainage ditch.
storyScope.centralViewerQuestion: Why did the suspect sprint away into the neighborhood ditch and what did he throw over the fence?
storyScope.primaryConflict: High-speed foot chase through obstacles; physical tackle and restraint in wet culvert.
storyScope.initialState: Officer approaches individual walking through private alleyway.
storyScope.targetEndState: Suspect is tackled, restrained in handcuffs, burglary tools recovered, and unexplained gunshot wound discovered.
storyScope.mainOpenLoop: What crime is the runner fleeing from and what is in the discarded black backpack?

centralViewerQuestion: Why did the suspect sprint away into the neighborhood ditch and what did he throw over the fence?
hookPromise: Kinetic, relentless foot pursuit through backyard fences ending in a ditch tackle and shocking injury reveal.

beats.newInformation: Officer shines flashlight down alley: 'Hey man, police department, stop right there!'
beats.viewerQuestionBefore: Will the pedestrian comply or run?
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Immediate tension hook without prologue delay.

beats.newInformation: Suspect suddenly turns, checks both corners, and bolts into an all-out sprint.
Bodycam shakes violently as officer sprints in pursuit, shouting into radio: 'Dispatch, foot chase westbound towards 5th!'
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Establishes tactical stakes and pursuit speed.

beats.newInformation: Suspect scales a 6-foot wooden privacy fence, tumbling headfirst into backyard.
Officer vaults fence and spots suspect discarding a heavy black backpack by a garden shed.
beats.viewerStateAfter: Evidence jettison spotted; mystery object created.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Creates central physical evidence open loop.

beats.newInformation: Chase enters overgrown culvert; officer screams: 'Stop or you are getting tased!'
Suspect loses footing on muddy concrete embankment, stumbling sideways.
Officer dives and wraps suspect in a full body tackle into the drainage ditch.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Direct physical climax of the foot chase.

beats.newInformation: Violent ground struggle as suspect flails and resists: 'Get off me, I can not breathe!'
Officer wrenches right arm behind back and snaps first steel handcuff onto wrist.
Backup officer Torres secures second wrist and double locks handcuffs on suspect.
Torres opens the discarded backpack, revealing heavy pry bars, lockpicks, and stolen diamond jewelry.
beats.viewerStateAfter: Burglary evidence confirmed; motive for running solved.

beats.newInformation: Suspect wheezes from ground: 'Someone paid me fifty dollars to carry that bag across the tracks!'
Officer cuts bloody shirt and discovers a fresh bullet entry wound in suspect right shoulder: 'He has been shot, call emergency EMS!'
beats.viewerStateAfter: Explosive discovery that suspect was shot before the chase began shifts incident to homicide/shootout investigation.
beats.cliffhangerQuestion: Who shot this suspect before police arrived, and was it a homeowner during the robbery in Part 2?
beats.cliffhangerNewInformation: Suspect has an active gunshot wound from a violent encounter prior to the foot chase.
beats.cliffhangerExpectedNextPayoff: Part 2 reveals EMS treatment and the homeowner shootout investigation.
